About the Site

404 On The Floor is my personal blog and website—a space where I collect thoughts, projects, and my personal interests in the realm of cybersecurity. I’m the only contributor. This is an IndieWeb site. I publish blog posts and notes documenting ideas and learnings. I write about these topics outside my day job for no purpose other than informing myself and having fun. Learn more about how I handle your data in my privacy policy.

About Me

Hi, I’m Purple Paradox.

I’m a security engineer based in the San Francisco Bay Area. During my career, I have had the opportunity to work with amazing people securing supply chains, automating processes, and leading technical projects.

I’m constantly working on personal projects. My journey includes writing documentation, creating requirements for my professional projects, and occasionally mentoring. See my resume for more details.
